T0525.title: Idempotency
T0525.definition: A property that allows repeated requests with the same intent to produce the same business result without duplicate side effects.
T0525.description: Idempotency prevents duplicate side effects when clients retry requests, networks fail, or attackers replay operations. It is commonly implemented with idempotency keys, request de-duplication, state-machine constraints, and unique transaction identifiers. Reviews should cover idempotency scope, expiration, concurrency races, and rollback behavior.
T0525.usageExample: Assess Idempotency related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
